summary: InMode Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results. The press release reports quarterly GAAP revenues of $95.6 million, flat year-over-year, and highlights a 13% increase in consumables and service revenues. The company also noted completion of a share repurchase of 6.38 million shares for $87.8 million under a previously announced program. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. The share repurchase is part of an ongoing program and does not constitute a separate capital return event. No transaction, strategic review, or management change is announced.
